card.name: Cardiac before arrhythmia or conduction
card.fires_on: The word cardiac (or the start of it) right before arrhythmia or conduction terms in drug interaction text. It also fires on linking words like 'such as' before conduction effects.

modes.label: Cardiac before arrhythmia
modes.description: The word cardiac after 'including', 'and' or 'such as', followed by arrhythmias.

modes.label: Card-iac in conduction headings
modes.description: The ending of cardiac in a heading about conduction effects of a drug.
modes.example: 7.2 Concomitant Medications that Affect Card<<iac>> Conduction Lacosamide should be used

modes.label: Odd radio-frequency cases
modes.description: Occasional hits inside radio and frequency text, such as a hyphen in direct-down conversion or a decimal point in GHz ranges.
modes.example: The SoC employs a direct<<-down>>conversion transceiver architecture
